comment.zh:
Tabby 是一款基于 Electron 的现代终端 / SSH 客户端，支持标签页、分屏、连接管理与内置 SFTP 面板。

Tabby 命令行不支持传递密码，首次连接时需在 Tabby 弹窗中粘贴一次密码；SFTP 可在连上后在标签页内手动打开。

!!!手动下载安装到「应用程序」，点击保存启用!!!
comment.en:
Tabby is a modern Electron-based terminal/SSH client with tabs, split panes, a connection manager and a built-in SFTP panel.

Tabby's CLI does not support passing a password, so you need to paste the password once in the Tabby prompt; the SFTP panel can be opened manually inside the tab afterwards.

!!!Manually download and install to /Applications, click Save to activate!!!
